cells.content:
## Readout
- **The 9.1% run was a single blocked precondition, not 10 broken features.** Run `crun_aaf24792d42fa94b` (16:24) failed 10/11 tests with the same `Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded.` signature across `admin/admin.spec.ts` and `auth/profile.spec.ts`. The immediate re-run `crun_7fe8c1ab9cc9d561` (16:34) went to **88.9% (8/9)** — 7 tests flipped to passing, 0 regressions. Root cause is login/2FA not completing within 30s, which cascades into every authenticated page.
- **Two tests carry all the residual risk.** `Admin login completes 2FA…` (health 42, flakiness 50%, 2/3 runs failed) and `Home page heading text…` (health 69, flakiness 50%) are the only two above the 20% flakiness threshold. Both are the same auth-gate and env-resolution problems.
- **The one genuine assertion failure is the open item.** `Home · TestverQA: page identity` failed the re-run with a bare `Failed` — a real expectation mismatch, not a timeout, and it is the only *new* failure vs. the prior run.
- **Failure categories are dominated by timeouts:** 11 timeout, 1 assertion, 1 environment (DNS). Fixing the auth-gate wait removes ~85% of all recorded failures.
- **Execution freshness is the weak metric (38/100).** Only 19 test cases executed in the last 7 days; the Sep 26 runs were single-test probes, so the 55-execution window is really 2 meaningful suite runs. Recommend a scheduled full-suite run to lift this.
- **API layer: no data.** `api_report summary` returned 0 calls — this report covers web/UI execution only.
